name: Tubulointerstitial Disease, Pyelonephritis and Renal Cysts

reference.pathophysiology: Ischaemic ATP loss detaches tubular cells plugging lumens while drug haptens inflame interstitium sparing glomeruli; ascending fimbriated bacilli scar refluxing kidneys asymmetrically, and polycystin failure cystifies tubules systemically.
